propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar project configuration while library defaults remain false.
Legacy unpinned attestations and current pinned targets must pass both enforcement gates without requiring migration or backfill.
Stale material-pin drift and missing plan-review gates must reject state transitions with appropriate error tokens and leave status unchanged.
Natural transitive invalidation must occur only after actual material changes; unchanged successful re-review must not propagate downstream.
Execution-time self-edit, in-progress-to-open reset, depends_on/blocks normalization, and deleted/archived target handling must be proven through public lifecycle surfaces.
Enable, disable, and re-enable policy behavior plus concurrent review/close changes and audited force-close must be verifiable without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation events.
